name: Ingco CS18568 1600W 185mm (7-1/4 Inch) 5000 RPM Circular Saw
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 1600W 185mm circular saw with 5000 RPM speed, cast aluminium baseplate, and 65mm cutting depth for rapid straight and bevel cuts in timber.
overview: The Ingco CS18568 is a high-power industrial circular saw engineered to deliver relentless cutting performance across timber, plywood, laminated panels, and structural timber frames. Powered by a heavy-duty 1600-watt motor spinning an 185mm (7-1/4 inch) 24-tooth carbide blade at 5000 RPM, it glides through tough hardwoods without bogging down. The die-cast aluminium baseplate features tool-free depth and angle adjustments, providing a maximum 65mm depth of cut at 90 degrees and 44mm at a 45-degree bevel. An integrated dust extraction port keeps the cut line visible and workspace clear.
keyFeatures: Heavy-duty 1600W industrial copper motor spinning at 5000 RPM
Generous cutting depth: 65 mm at 90° perpendicular and 44 mm at 45° bevel
Die-cast aluminium protective upper and lower guards with quick-retract lever
Sturdy pressed aluminium shoe plate with laser-etched depth and angle scales
Spindle lock button allows quick, safe single-wrench blade changeovers
Soft rubberized ergonomic handle with secondary guide grip for two-handed control
Includes heavy-gauge parallel guide fence for precise rip cutting
applications: Ripping and cross-cutting dimensional construction timber
Sizing plywood, OSB, and MDF panels on building sites
Trimming concrete formwork and roof purlins
Cutting composite decking and exterior wood siding
